home.first.text: Hi, I'm Rooky! Tap The Journey to travel through time with me, or tap Quick Play for a game with an animal friend.

home.text: Welcome back! Tap The Journey to carry on your adventure, or tap Quick Play for a fun game.

home.resume.text: Your game is waiting for you! Tap Resume Game, and carry on where you left off.

play.text: Pick an animal friend to play with. If you're new, start with Truffle the bunny. Each friend is a little stronger than the last.

journey.text: Every era is a new adventure! Tap an open era, and meet the friend who lives there.

learn.text: Pick a lesson, and I'll teach you, step by step. Start at the top, and work your way down.

puzzles.text: Puzzles are little treasure hunts. Pick one, then find the best move.

training.text: Let's practise! Pick a skill, and we'll work on it together.

minis.text: Mini-games are quick! Pick one, and beat your best score.

mini.text: Tap the scroll if you need the rules. Have fun!

openings.text: Openings are the first moves of a game. Pick one, and try it on the board.

dojo.text: Endgames are the end of a game, when only a few pieces are left. Pick one, and win it, step by step.

collection.text: This is your collection! Tap anything to see it up close, and I will tell you all about it. Then tap Equip, to put it on your table.

profile.text: This is you! Here you can see your level, your games, and your badges.

club.text: Welcome to the Club! See how you rank, climb the leagues, and find the friends you play with a code.

season.text: Play games, learn, and solve puzzles to climb the season. Every tier has a prize!

store.text: This part is for grown-ups. Please ask a grown-up before you buy anything.

review.text: Let's look back at your game. Tap the arrows, and step through it, one move at a time.

game.white.text: You go first! Tap one of your pieces, then tap the square where you want it to go.

game.black.text: Your friend moves first. Watch their move, and then it's your turn!

game.check.text: Uh oh, your king is in check! Move it to safety, block the attack, or take the attacker.

game.idle.text: Take your time. If you're stuck, tap Hint, and I'll show you a good idea.

game.over.text: Good game! Tap Review with Rooky to see your best moves, or play again.

lesson.steps.text: Let's learn! Listen, and watch the board. Then tap Next, when you're ready.

lesson.ex.text: Now it's your turn! Move a piece on the board, to answer.

lesson.idle.text: Need some help? Tap Hint, and I'll give you a clue.

lesson.done.text: Well done, you finished the lesson! Tap the gold button to carry on.

puzzle.start.text: Find the best move! Look for checks, captures, and threats.

puzzle.wrong.text: Good try! Have another look, or tap Hint for a clue.

puzzle.idle.text: Stuck? Tap Hint, and I'll give you a clue.

puzzle.solved.text: You did it! Tap Next puzzle, to keep going.

era.egypt.puzzles.text: Well done! Next, tap Tomb treasure, and solve my puzzles.

era.egypt.champion.text: You're ready! Tap Miu's challenge, and play me. Win, and the Pharaoh's Treasure set is yours!

placement.offer.text: Have you played chess before? Take my short test, and I'll pick your first lesson and a friend to play. Or skip it, and we'll start at the beginning.

placement.q01.text: Tap every square the rook can reach. Remember, it can take a black piece, but not jump over one.

placement.q02.text: Now the knight. Tap every square it can jump to.

placement.q03.text: Your knight can take a piece. Take the one that nobody guards.

placement.q04.text: Give check with your queen, on a square where she cannot be taken.

placement.q06.text: The black king is stuck behind his pawns. Find checkmate in one move.

placement.q07.text: Find a knight move that attacks the king and the rook at once.

placement.q08.text: White moves first. Can the black king catch the pawn before it becomes a queen?

placement.q09.text: Your opponent has just moved. Find the best move, then keep going.

placement.q10.text: Last one, and the hardest. Find the best move, then keep going.

placement.r1.text: Thanks for trying! We'll start at the very beginning, with how the pieces move. You'll pick it up in no time!

placement.r2.text: Nice work! You know how the pieces move, so we'll start with check and checkmate.

placement.r3.text: Great job! You know the rules, so your path starts with opening ideas.

placement.r4.text: Wow, you spotted the fork! You're ready for tactics, like forks and pins.

placement.r5.text: Amazing, you found nearly everything! You're ready to learn defence and king safety.

variants.text: Chess has cousins from all over the world! Pick one to learn its rules, then play it.

variant.text: Here are the rules on one page. The gold ones are not like chess. Try my short lesson, then pick a friend to play.

variant.chaturanga.hello.text: Long ago in India, chess had another name: chaturanga. It means the four parts of an army. Let's play it the old way!

variant.chaturanga.same.text: The king, the horse and the chariot move just like our king, knight and rook. The foot soldiers are the pawns.

variant.chaturanga.mantri.text: Next to the king stands the Mantri, his wise counsellor. He takes one small step, on a slant. Much later, he grew into the queen!

variant.chaturanga.gaja.text: The Gaja is a war elephant. It jumps exactly two squares on a slant, right over anything in the way. It grew into the bishop.

variant.chaturanga.soldier.text: Foot soldiers march one square at a time, even on their first move. A soldier who reaches the far side becomes a Mantri.

variant.chaturanga.castle.text: There is no castling in chaturanga. Walk your king to safety, one step at a time.

variant.chaturanga.win.text: Checkmate still wins. You also win if you capture every enemy piece except the king. And a king with no move at all loses too!

variant.chaturanga.ex.mantri.text: Tap every square the Mantri can step to.

variant.chaturanga.ex.gaja.text: Tap every square the Gaja can jump to.

variant.chaturanga.ex.bare.text: Capture Black's last piece, and leave the king all alone.

variant.chaturanga.ex.promote.text: This foot soldier is about to reach the far side. What will he become?

variant.chaturanga.ex.stuck.text: Find a move that leaves Black with no move at all. In chaturanga, that wins!

variant.chess960.hello.text: A world champion called Bobby Fischer had a fun idea: shuffle the back row before every game! It is called Chess960.

variant.chess960.mirror.text: Look closely. Black's pieces copy White's, file by file, like a mirror. The pawns stay right where they always are.

variant.chess960.order.text: There are only two rules for the shuffle. The bishops stand on different colours, and the king stands between the rooks.

variant.chess960.castle.text: Castling ends just like in chess: the king on the g-file or the c-file, the rook right beside it. To castle, move your king onto your rook.

variant.chess960.think.text: Nobody knows the openings here, so think from your very first move. Bring out your pieces and keep your king safe.

variant.chess960.ex.short.text: Castle on the king's side. Put your king on the rook on h1.

variant.chess960.ex.long.text: Now castle on the queen's side, towards the a-file.

variant.chess960.ex.land.text: If White castles on the king's side here, where does the king land?

variant.chess960.ex.rule.text: Which rule is always true in Chess960?

variant.koth.hello.text: Welcome to King of the Hill! The four squares in the middle are the hill. Get your king up there and you win.

variant.koth.hill.text: See the glowing squares? d4, e4, d5 and e5. One step onto any of them wins the game at once.

variant.koth.safe.text: But a king can never step onto a square an enemy guards. This rook guards the fourth row, so those hill squares are closed.

variant.koth.block.text: So watch the enemy king too! If it gets close to the hill, guard the hill squares before it climbs.

variant.koth.same.text: Checkmate still wins, and every piece moves just like in chess. Now, let's climb!

variant.koth.ex.climb.text: Walk your king onto the hill.

variant.koth.ex.stop.text: Black's king wants the hill. Stop it with one rook move.

variant.koth.ex.guarded.text: The bishop guards one hill square. Find the safe one and climb.

variant.threecheck.hello.text: In Three-check, every check counts! Give check three times and you win, even without checkmate.

variant.threecheck.count.text: White's bishop just gave check, so White's counter shows one. The counters sit beside the players' names.

variant.threecheck.safe.text: So keep your king tucked away. Don't open lines toward it too early, or the checks pile up fast.

variant.threecheck.same.text: Checkmate still wins, and every piece moves just like in chess. Let's practise!

variant.threecheck.ex.third.text: You have given two checks. Give the third and win.

variant.threecheck.ex.knight.text: Two checks done. Can your knight give the third?

variant.threecheck.ex.what.text: What happens when you give your third check?
